content.text: {"id": "mm6508e1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "During August 1, 2015–February 10, 2016, CDC received 257 requests for Zika virus testing for pregnant women."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "249 (97%) tested negative for recent Zika virus infection and eight (3%) had confirmed Zika virus infection."}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among these requests, 151 (59%) included information indicating that the woman had a clinical illness"}]}, {"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among the six pregnant women with Zika virus disease who reported symptoms during the first trimester, outcomes included two early pregnancy losses"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "All nine women reported at least one of the four most commonly observed symptoms"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among the six pregnant women with Zika virus disease who reported symptoms during the first trimester, outcomes included two early pregnancy losses"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Additional testing performed as of February 24, 2016 identified no confirmed cases among 162 pregnant women without reported symptoms."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "case report/series", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "In this small case series, Zika virus infection during pregnancy was associated with a range of outcomes"}]}, {"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "As of February 17, 2016, nine U.S. pregnant travelers with Zika virus infection had been identified."}]}], "methods_quotes": [], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["data_focus", "outcome_types", "analytic_depth"]}
